items.title: Concept A flat token HP bars, overlays & count-down HP on sheets/HUD
items.do: Open Aveline and Orc Warrior on the canvas and sheets. Deal Vigor Lethal, Vigor Nonlethal, Resolve damage, Guard, overflow past Vigor threshold (Bloodied), Strained, Down, and Dead (0 HP).
items.expect: Token bars show flat matte converging Vigor (crimson, left) & Resolve (cobalt, right) with brass center pin, type-colored Nonlethal hatches, directional overflow hatches across the pin, Guard crown bar above, and crisp rim vignettes + micro-ribbons (Bloodied, Strained, Dying/Shattered/Unconscious, faded Dead — no giant Foundry skull overlay). PC/NPC sheets and HUD count down from max (0 = Bloodied/Strained, negative on overflow).

items.title: 32 custom tactical condition SVG icons & Heraldic Portrait Seal marks
items.do: Apply several conditions on Orc Warrior via the Token HUD or Actions (e.g. Vulnerable, Daunted, Prone, Empowered, Slowed, Exhausted, Grabbed, Lingering). Have Aveline use Judge and Sylwen use Mark Quarry on the same Orc Warrior.
items.expect: All 32 conditions display crisp custom tactical SVG icons across the Token HUD, sheets, and HUD condition pills (with Frightened removed). Judge shows a gilded 8-point starburst Portrait Seal and Mark Quarry shows a crimson broadhead Portrait Seal stacked cleanly along the token's right edge without overlapping.

items.title: Save Roll Dialog named chips & live Modifier Breakdown
items.do: Put Vulnerable 1 on Orc Warrior, have Aveline use Word of Radiance (or switch it to Nonlethal, or cast while Daunted/Bane) so Orc Warrior is inside with Low or High Cover, then click Orc Warrior's Save button on the chat card.
items.expect: Vulnerable 1, Cover (Low/Medium/High), Nonlethal Save, and Caster's Banes appear as named toggleable chips (not anonymous Boon/Bane counters), and a live Modifier Breakdown line appears directly under the roll formula updating as you toggle chips or manual modifiers.

items.title: Setup-move Actions show "Modifiers before Setup" reminder
items.do: On Kaela's turn, open Strafe's Roll Dialog (or Charge on Aveline); compare with opening Basic Attack's Roll Dialog.
items.expect: Strafe / Charge shows a subtle bronze-bordered note above the Roll button ("Setup movement runs after Roll: set any manual modifiers now — range, Cover, and Flanking update automatically after you move."); Basic Attack does not show it.

items.title: Feint T2 (+2 Boons), T3 (Favored) & Critical (no Reactions vs. you)
items.do: On Sylwen's turn (GM Force Tier), use Feint on Orc Warrior (target A) with a second enemy (target B) nearby: (1) Force T2 — open Basic Attack vs target B, then vs target A and roll; (2) Force T3 — check Basic Attack vs target A; (3) Force Critical (accept Critical row) — move Sylwen away from Orc Warrior (Opportunity Attack) vs moving Kaela away.
items.expect: (1) T2 gives +2 Boons vs target A only and is NOT consumed by striking target B, then expires after striking target A; (2) T3 makes next Strike vs target A Favored; (3) Critical blocks Orc Warrior's Opportunity Attack against Sylwen ("Feinted: no Reactions vs. Sylwen") until EoT, while Kaela still triggers it normally.

items.title: Quick Shots & Darting Blade auto-start Evade 2 after rolling
items.do: On Sylwen's turn in combat, roll Quick Shots (and try Darting Blade too) against an enemy.
items.expect: Immediately after rolling, Evade 2 starts automatically with the movement range and HUD Evade banner (no extra click on the chat card Evade button); Roll Damage works normally; Darting Blade still prompts to stow its Light weapon once Evade ends.

items.title: Reaction "Move back" ruler reset + Large Push aiming & wall slam damage
items.do: (a) Trigger an enemy Opportunity Attack by dragging Sylwen away in combat, then click "Move back" on the Reaction card. (b) Use Shove / Push 3 on Large (2×2) Ogre Chieftain — hover squares directly off its right/bottom outer edge and diagonally off its corners; also push a creature standing right next to a wall or another creature by hovering just 1 square into the wall/creature (and compare hovering 1–2 squares in open space).
items.expect: (a) Move back refunds 2d12 movement AND resets Foundry's movement ruler/history cleanly; (b) Large 2×2 Push aims smoothly from every outer edge & diagonal (hovering inside the Ogre's own squares does not aim Push 1, and the farthest gold squares are reachable); aiming into an adjacent wall/creature automatically computes full N-square collision damage (while clicking 1–2 squares in open space still allows a short push).
